sections.text: ZBTB16::RARA was RT-PCR-confirmed in 18 patients in a 24-patient series of rare RARA-rearranged AML with APL-like morphology.

sections.text: In the rare-RARA series, no evident ATRA/ATO-induced differentiation was observed in ZBTB16::RARA-positive cases despite frequent retinoid exposure; treatment responses to combination regimens do not establish retinoid sensitivity.

report_comment.text: ZBTB16 encodes PLZF, a zinc-finger transcriptional repressor involved in development and differentiation. RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha, a ligand-regulated nuclear-receptor transcription factor. ZBTB16::RARA was RT-PCR-confirmed in 18 patients in a 24-patient series of rare RARA-rearranged AML with APL-like morphology. In the rare-RARA series, no evident ATRA/ATO-induced differentiation was observed in ZBTB16::RARA-positive cases despite frequent retinoid exposure; treatment responses to combination regimens do not establish retinoid sensitivity.
